title: Global annihilation proof search: recurrence, dissipation and arithmetic invariance
question: Can the relational proximity analogy be promoted to a valid global law that annihilates every RH defect with no reservoir?

verdict.conclusion: The exact proof is a Lyapunov recurrence argument: an invariant xi ledger under a strict defect contraction must have zero defect.  Exhaustive reflection/golden/halving words confirm that exact return and strict contraction coexist only at eta=0.  But known xi symmetry supplies return without contraction, while every strict contraction changes the divisor.  Heat, inner-factor and prime-damping candidates also change the function or restate RH.  The implication is proved; its arithmetic-invariance premise is not.  RH remains open.

globalAnnihilationTheorem.lyapunovFunctional: V(mu)=total positive off-line defect (or horizontal second moment)
globalAnnihilationTheorem.strictDissipationNeeded: V(T_# nu)<=q V(nu) for the xi ledger, with 0<=q<1
globalAnnihilationTheorem.proof: V(mu_xi)=V(T_#mu_xi)<=q V(mu_xi), hence (1-q)V(mu_xi)<=0; nonnegativity gives V(mu_xi)=0
globalAnnihilationTheorem.status: the implication is proved; no derived T simultaneously satisfies arithmetic invariance and strict dissipation

stripMapNoGo.statement: after conformally mapping the strip to the disk, a holomorphic self-map fixing the center is contractive by Schwarz; if a positive iterate is the identity, it is an automorphism and its derivative has modulus one
stripMapNoGo.consequence: a strict holomorphic contraction cannot also be an exact finite-order return, except on the central fixed state
stripMapNoGo.effectOnTti: the exact double inversion can represent reflection or rotation, but not horizontal shrinkage without an additional non-invertible/open-system step

deBruijnNewmanGate.family: H(lambda,z)=integral exp(lambda u^2) Phi(u) cos(zu) du
deBruijnNewmanGate.knownThresholdStatement: all zeros are real exactly for lambda>=Lambda
deBruijnNewmanGate.rhCriterion: RH iff Lambda<=0; together with the lower bound this is RH iff Lambda=0
deBruijnNewmanGate.gate: the heat flow changes H_lambda; proving that real-zero global annihilation has already occurred at lambda=0 is exactly RH
